groups.title: Social sign-in: 2 centred buttons on live vs a row of 8 in the design
groups.summary: The design shows a full-width row of 8 round social buttons (Google, Facebook, Apple, LinkedIn, Microsoft, LINE, KakaoTalk, passkey) starting at x=870. Live shows only Google and Facebook, centred at x=1034, so the remaining icons are missing and the matcher pairs the wrong icons (Microsoft vs Facebook colour).

groups.title: "Send me recommendations" checkbox missing on live
groups.summary: The design has an orange checked checkbox with the label "Send me recommendations" under the social buttons; live has no opt-in row at all.

groups.title: Create account button 6px taller, label nearly invisible on live
groups.summary: The disabled Create account pill is 52px tall on live vs 46px in the design, and its label is so faint on live it isn't detected (design label is a readable mid grey).

groups.title: "or" separator: lighter text and stronger rules on live, 10px lower
groups.summary: The "or" divider below the button: live text is a pale grey #b9b9b9 (design #6e7b84, blue-grey) and the horizontal rules either side are darker and get detected only on live. It also sits ~10px lower because the button is taller.

groups.title: Form header spacing: 4px more gap under subtitle, 3px under Password label
groups.summary: Live's "Create an account" heading block sits 5-7px higher, with the gap under "Already have an account? Log in" growing 21→25px, and the gap between the PASSWORD label and its field growing 8→11px. Same field-label/stack spacing difference.

groups.title: Heading ink neutral #171717 on live vs blue-tinted #0e2332
groups.summary: The "Create an account" heading uses the design's blue-tinted ink (#0e2332); live uses neutral near-black #171717.

groups.title: Marketing headline 3px smaller on live
groups.summary: "Better work in half the time." on the left panel is set smaller on live (31px → 28px text height, line narrower).

groups.title: Legal copy rewritten (adds terms acceptance line)
groups.summary: Below the form, live adds "By signing up you accept our Privacy Policy, Terms & Licensing Agreement" before the reCAPTCHA notice, so the block is 4 lines instead of 2.

groups.title: Asset stats line differs (live numbers, no "added yesterday")
groups.summary: First check-list item on the marketing panel: design reads "Access 74,540,405 creative assets (89,304 added yesterday)", live "Access 60,869,326 creative assets". Sample data vs live data.

groups.title: Button top edge read as a divider
groups.summary: The 366×1 "divider" at y=456 is the top edge of live's Create account pill, picked up as a line; covered by the button-height group.
